question:
Fill in the blank with the suitable option.

 We must __________ on our spiritual journey by first understanding the grace and significance of a pilgrimage.
solution:
The correct answer is '**embark**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**embark**" means to begin a journey, especially one that is important or challenging.
 
• In the context of the sentence, "embark" is the most suitable option as it conveys the idea of starting a spiritual journey.
 
• The other options, such as "**embitter**," "**launch**," and "**embrace**," do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *We must embark__ on our spiritual journey by first understanding the grace and significance of a pilgrimage.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Embitter (कड़वाहट पैदा करना)**: means to make someone feel resentful or bitter.
 
• **Launch (प्रारंभ करना)**: means to start or introduce something, but it doesn't convey the sense of a journey.
 
• **Embrace (गले लगाना)**: means to accept or welcome something willingly, but it doesn't fit the context of beginning a journey.
